# Packworkz

> Packworkz is an AI-enabled managed packaging platform in India. Brands design, price, order, quality-check and ship custom packaging — pouches, rollstock, bottles, jars, tubes, cartons, rigid boxes, mailers and labels — through one team, with instant online pricing for standard formats and a confirmed price within 4 business hours for custom work. Packworkz also matches brands with contract and private-label manufacturers (Packworkz Make), packaging machinery (Packworkz Machinery) and recyclers for production scrap (Packworkz Circular). Prices are charged in INR.

Key facts:
- 66 packaging product families with minimum order quantities shown on each product page.
- Sample kit: ₹299 + ₹100 shipping, 25+ pieces, delivered across India.
- Packworkz Make lists 81 contract and private-label manufacturers across 16 consumer categories. Introductions are free with 0% commission; Launch Desk (₹14,999 one-time) runs the shortlist, quotes and samples for a brand.
- Backed by Kalyani Rotopack's 33-year manufacturing heritage. Contact: +91 82089 90366.
- Full detail for language models: https://packworkz.com/llms-full.txt

## Start here
- [Packworkz — Packaging Manufacturer & Managed Platform India](https://packworkz.com): Managed packaging for D2C, FMCG, pharma and enterprise teams. Browse a curated product catalog, see quantity pricing, create 3D previews and manage repeat orders in one workflow.
- [Packaging Products India](https://packworkz.com/products): Browse curated packaging families including pouches, rigid boxes, cartons, containers, mailers, labels, food-service packs and technical rollstock. See buying paths and quantity pricing online.
- [Packaging Sample Kit India](https://packworkz.com/samples): Buy a curated kit of 25–50+ packaging samples, material swatches and finishes for ₹299 plus ₹100 shipping across India. Pay securely with Razorpay.
- [How to Source Custom Packaging in India](https://packworkz.com/how-it-works): Source custom packaging in 4 simple steps. Submit specs, get competitive pricing plans in 48 hours, approve samples, track production. India's simplest managed packaging sourcing process.
- [Enterprise Packaging Procurement & Manufacturing India](https://packworkz.com/enterprise): Consolidate packaging sourcing, manufacturing, QC, compliance and logistics with Packworkz. Built for FMCG, D2C, food, beauty, pharma and multi-SKU procurement teams.
- [Contact Packworkz](https://packworkz.com/contact): Contact Packworkz for custom packaging pricing, sample orders, or design enquiries. Call +91 82089 90366 or send an enquiry online.

## Machinery and recycling
- [Packaging Machines for D2C & Food Brands India](https://packworkz.com/machinery): Impulse, band, induction and vacuum sealers, tube, powder and liquid fillers, batch coders, labellers and automatic VFFS lines — matched to your product and output, with packaging that runs on them.
- [Sell Packaging & Plastic Scrap](https://packworkz.com/circular): Turn film trim, laminate offcuts, corrugated and plastic rejects into revenue. Get per-kg quotes from registered recyclers, with pickup, weighbridge slips and documentation.

- [D2C Packaging Manufacturer India](https://packworkz.com/industries/d2c): Custom branded packaging for D2C brands including stand-up pouches, mailers, printed cartons and rigid gift boxes, with low-MOQ options and managed production support.
- [FMCG Packaging Manufacturer India](https://packworkz.com/industries/fmcg): High-volume FMCG packaging from India's verified manufacturer network. Flexible pouches, glass jars, cartons, labels and more. Net-30 credit available.

- [Beauty & Cosmetics Packaging Manufacturer India](https://packworkz.com/industries/beauty): Custom cosmetics packaging — airless pumps, glass jars, aluminium tubes, serum bottles and luxury boxes. Low MOQ, custom branding, pre-dispatch QC.
- [Food Packaging Manufacturer India](https://packworkz.com/industries/food): FSSAI-compliant food packaging — stand-up pouches, flat bottom bags, spout pouches, kraft boxes and more. Custom printing, retort pouches, and bulk orders available.
- [Electronics Packaging Manufacturer India](https://packworkz.com/industries/electronics): Anti-static bags, ESD-safe packaging, corrugated inserts and custom foam for electronics brands. Full compliance documentation. Low MOQ, pan-India delivery.
- [Export Packaging Manufacturer India](https://packworkz.com/industries/exports): Packaging for Indian exporters targeting UAE, US, UK, and Europe. SASO-ready, FDA-grade, FSC-certified with full chain-of-custody documentation.
- [Luxury & Gift Packaging Manufacturer India](https://packworkz.com/industries/luxury): Premium gift boxes, rigid suitcases, and luxury packaging for jewellery, watches and lifestyle brands. Low MOQ, custom finishes.
